## Changelog

- Added Update and Restart with signed regional downloads, progress, version verification and native installation.
- Added counter and session save requests before update installation and restart.
- Made remembered login in macOS Keychain the default and removed the startup storage-choice prompt.
- Renamed both regional apps to Wuwa Tappo while preserving their separate accounts, settings and counters.

## Instructions

- Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 13 or later.
- Choose the `CN` package for a mainland China account or `Global` for a Global account.
- Quit the existing app, then drag the app from the DMG into Applications, or extract the ZIP and move the app there.
- If macOS blocks launch, open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
- Upgrade from mac.4 or earlier manually once to enable future in-app updates. Quit and remove the older regional-named app after installing this version.
- Both packages contain `Wuwa Tappo.app`. Install them in separate folders if you want to keep both regions.
- For future updates, open Settings → Check for Updates → Update and Restart. macOS may request administrator approval.
- Use DMG/ZIP files for manual installation; `.app.tar.gz` and `.sig` files are for the in-app updater.
